title: Frequency design areas 3a (Feed kit port), 3b (Circle), 4 (Settings, Vault, Journey, admin widgets), 6 (push error position, Start a Circle icon) and the members-ui.css bridge cleanup
detail:
Parked 2026-10-14, active 2026-10-19. OWNER STEP FIRST: the handoff doc ("Frequency design system: build handoff", 2026-10-14) is not in design_handoff/ or /mnt/project-files; its scope survives only in /mnt/project-files/merge-order/queue-2026-10-14.md. The owner re-attaches it, then the Mac session splits this into one row per area. Today feed-body.tsx:19 imports loadGameStats from components/sidebar/right-sidebar and app/(main)/feed/page.tsx imports components/feed/*.

ABSORBED 2026-10-20: SCAN-860 (rank colours) merged into this row. NARROWED 2026-10-20: the blocker above (owner re-attaches the handoff doc) is stale; Feed and Circle (areas 3a, 3b) are design-plan items 23 to 26 owned by the Feed and Circles thread. What stays here: area 4 (Settings, Vault, Journey, admin widgets), area 6, the members-ui.css bridge cleanup and the rank-hue ruling. 2026-10-20: area 6 (push error position, Start a Circle icon) shipped as LIVE-1100. Left here: area 4 (Settings, Vault, Journey, admin widgets), the members-ui.css bridge cleanup and the rank-hue ruling. Admin kit switch style and admin switches shipped as LIVE-1102. Settings switches moved to the shared Switch as LIVE-1101. Vault Trophy case moved to the kit as LIVE-1103.

CLOSED 2026-10-20: Vault Store moved to the kit as LIVE-1104, the last area-4 piece in scope. Journey: the Frequency Journey bodies already draw in the kit and import only course-home's upNext/playHref logic, no DAWN view. Bridge: members-ui.css part 2 is not a bridge any more; it is the live fallback for Frequency pages outside a kit and for the Commons body of the public site, so it stays. Part 4 (DAWN idioms) and the hand-built switch rule still serve pages other threads own (Profile side, event page, Journey details, Circle menus, block editor toggles); their comments now list exactly those. Feed and Circle (3a, 3b) belong to design-plan items 23 to 26. The rank-colour ruling stays on its own row, SCAN-860, with Daniel's card open.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=p=>fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');const bad=[];const v=r('components/frequency/members/vault/vault-body.tsx');if(v.includes(\"from '@/components/quest/trophy-case'\")||v.includes(\"from '@/components/widgets/vault/vault-store'\"))bad.push('the Frequency Vault mounts a DAWN Trophy case or Vault Store');for(const f of ['resonance-matching-toggle','live-location-toggle','match-prefs-form','consent-scopes-form'])if(!r('components/settings/'+f+'.tsx').includes('<Switch '))bad.push(f+' is a hand-built switch');if(!r('app/(main)/settings/notifications/form.tsx').includes(\"'sw on' : 'sw'\"))bad.push('the notifications grid lost the kit switch');if(!r('app/themes/frequency/admin-pages.css').includes('[data-kit=\\\"admin\\\"] .sw{'))bad.push('the admin kit has no .sw');if(!r('components/push/registration.tsx').includes('fq-push-note'))bad.push('the push note lost its kit position');if(!r('components/compose/new-circle-compose.tsx').includes('<FqIcon name=\\\"plus\\\"'))bad.push('Start a Circle lost the kit plus');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-938: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the Frequency Vault, Settings switches, admin kit switch, push note or Start a Circle icon slip back to DAWN. Behavior lives in each LIVE-1100..1104 test.
